snippet.title: Silver Service - Official Trailer | Cozy Co-op Tidying Game
snippet.description:
A cozy first-person tidying game set aboard an ocean liner. Put 11,132 portions
back where they belong, solo or with up to 3 friends.

Out 6 November 2026 on Steam.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5413320/

The passengers have gone ashore. The kitchens have done their part. Every dish
is plated and waiting, and not one of them is where it should be.

Fill your tray and set every portion back on the display waiting for it.
Over 200 recipes across five rooms: the Brasserie and its cold cuts, the Boba
Bar and its syrups, the Sushi Bar, the Tea Room and its pastries, and the Grand
Buffet where everything ends up. Learn where each one belongs. Reach the last plate.

WHAT'S IN IT
- 11,132 portions to put away across five dining rooms
- Over 200 recipes to learn
- Online co-op for up to 4 players
- Upgrades that make you faster: a bigger tray, longer reach, a service trolley
- Fishing, a camera and a bestiary to fill between services
- No cooking, no customers, no timer

Developed by Eyzulabs. Published by Swiplay.

#cozygames #indiegame #coopgames
